notes.made: --init (frames, waist, below), then by hand, from scratch (24fdc43cf on claude/run-char was rejected: 「李青模型脸部严重变形」 - his own jaw and knot bits were left outside the laid head): lock head - his drawn run redraws the head every frame (colour-IoU against frame 1's 0.51-0.71), the arms, the braid, the blindfold's tails and the sash swing as drawn
notes.head: frame 1's skull, blindfold, gem, bun and jaw (the closest to his idle's: colour-IoU 0.57; the others 0.45-0.54), on the frame's own gem and blindfold (head_match_colours; the gold of the knot pulled frame 3 7 rows off), no chin alignment: his jaw runs into his bare neck and chest in the same skin, so the head stays where the frame's own gem is
notes.clear_poly: the clearing (all colours, clear_all) stops at the jaw line and the back of the neck: his shoulders and chest are the face's own skin
notes.head_carry: the braid, its gold tie on the bun, the blindfold's two tails (up and back) as each frame draws them - offset 0 (the head is laid where the frame's own is), so they only keep every square from the clearing; one gold tie a frame (the laid head has none)
notes.beside_head: outline: what a frame's longer jaw leaves under the laid one is closed with outline, never filled with skin (a skin fill there is the jaw patch the user saw)
